title: Protein-Ligand DMS, BindingDB & BioLiP Benchmark
subtitle: 137 Protein-Ligand DMS Cohorts (561k), BindingDB & BioLiP-175 Dependency Maps
description:
# Protein–Ligand DMS, BindingDB & BioLiP Benchmark

Curated protein–small-molecule benchmark dataset used in **LogiCA** (*Contextualizing Biological Language Models via Logit-Space Contrastive Alignment*), packaging:
- **137 Protein–Ligand DMS & Enzyme Kinetics Cohorts (`561,059` variants)** (`dms_tasks/` + `cohorts.csv`), with `LOCO-30%` (unseen protein superfamily), `LOLO` (unseen chemical scaffold), and `Oncology LOO` splits;
- **Precomputed Zero-Shot Baseline Scores** (`baseline_scores/`) kept separate from experimental tables (`LogiCA`, `ESM-2 650M`, `ESM-C 600M`, `VenusREM`, `PoET`, `MoCHI`, `CatPred`, `LigandMPNN`, `SaProt`, `ThermoMPNN`);
- **Stage-0 Curated BindingDB Pretraining Corpus** (`bindingdb_pretrain/`: `10,235` single-chain domain-windowed proteins, `1,127,953` RDKit-desalted SMILES/SELFIES compounds, `1,631,404` train + `222,547` `<30%`-homology val pairs);
- **BioLiP-175 `<5 Å` Contact Localization Benchmark & Precomputed Dependency Maps** (`biolip_175/`: `175` crystal complexes, `5` protein-disjoint targets, `44,337` residue observations, `1,060` contacts, plus 6 per-residue LogiCA dependency map profiles and 14-model benchmark summary).

---

## Related Links
- **Code & Pretrained Model Loader**: [github.com/AI-SysBio/LogiCA](https://github.com/AI-SysBio/LogiCA/tree/main/applications/protein-ligand)
- **Pretrained `ESM-2 + SELFormer` LogiCA Checkpoints (`8M`–`650M`)**: [huggingface.co/Yale-CompBio/logica](https://huggingface.co/Yale-CompBio/logica)
- **Companion TCR–Peptide DMS Dataset**: [kaggle.com/datasets/aurlienplissier/tcr-peptide-dms](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/aurlienplissier/tcr-peptide-dms)
- **Companion Antibody–Antigen Benchmark (AbRank v2)**: [kaggle.com/datasets/aurlienplissier/abrank](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/aurlienplissier/abrank)

---

## Directory Layout

| Directory / File | Contents |
| :--- | :--- |
| `cohorts.csv` | Master index of all `137` cohorts (`103` mutational DMS + `34` WT enzyme kinetics) with `LOCO-30%`, `LOLO`, and `Oncology LOO` split IDs |
| `dms_tasks/*.parquet` | 8 harmonized experimental DMS/kinetics tables (`561,059` variants, `22` standardized columns, no model predictions mixed in) |
| `baseline_scores/*_baselines.parquet` | 8 aligned tables storing precomputed zero-shot scores for 10 protein/structure/ligand baselines |
| `bindingdb_pretrain/` | `proteins.parquet` (`10,235`), `drugs.parquet` (`1,127,953`), `train_pairs.parquet` (`1,631,404`), `val_pairs.parquet` (`222,547`), `curation_summary.json` |
| `biolip_175/` | `model_inputs.parquet`, `evaluation_windows.parquet`, `residue_labels.parquet`, `model_input_protein_positions.parquet` |
| `biolip_175/dependency_maps/` | `biolip_dependency_profiles.parquet` (6 LogiCA per-residue dependency maps on all `44,337` residues), `biolip_metrics_per_interaction.csv`, `biolip_model_summary.csv` |
| `metadata/` | `SOURCES_AND_LICENSES.md` and per-source JSON manifests (`source_manifests/`) |

---

## Quickstart

```python
from pathlib import Path
import kagglehub
import pandas as pd

root = Path(kagglehub.dataset_download("aurlienplissier/protein-ligand-dms"))

# 1. Load cohort metadata and pure experimental DMS variants
cohorts = pd.read_csv(root / "cohorts.csv")
kinase_dms = pd.read_parquet(root / "dms_tasks/kinase_inhibitor_panel_dms.parquet")
kinase_baselines = pd.read_parquet(root / "baseline_scores/kinase_inhibitor_panel_dms_baselines.parquet")

# 2. Load BindingDB Stage-1 pretraining corpus
bdb_train = pd.read_parquet(root / "bindingdb_pretrain/train_pairs.parquet")
bdb_drugs = pd.read_parquet(root / "bindingdb_pretrain/drugs.parquet")

# 3. Load BioLiP-175 <5 A contact labels & precomputed LogiCA dependency maps
biolip_labels = pd.read_parquet(root / "biolip_175/residue_labels.parquet")
biolip_deps = pd.read_parquet(root / "biolip_175/dependency_maps/biolip_dependency_profiles.parquet")
```

Run directly with **`AI-SysBio/LogiCA`**:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/AI-SysBio/LogiCA.git && cd LogiCA
pip install -e ".[chem]"
python applications/protein-ligand/scripts/01_download_and_process_dms_data.py --kaggle-dataset aurlienplissier/protein-ligand-dms
python applications/protein-ligand/scripts/04_evaluate_dependency_maps_biolip.py --kaggle-dataset aurlienplissier/protein-ligand-dms --scale 35m
```
